SHÙ Mandarin Number Gym — prepared audio provenance, Google Translate v1

Source: Google Translate speech functionality through gTTS 2.5.4.
Language: zh-CN (Chinese Simplified / Mandarin); domain: com; slow: false.
The original returned MP3 bytes are stored without time stretching, pitch changes,
normalization, transcoding or extra punctuation. Normal playback is 1.0 for every
mode and level. Optional slow replay uses pitch-preserving 0.8 playback.

Owner-approved voice reference: 十四点零五分 / 14:05 (2026-10-31).
Reference file: audio/gt-v1-reference-14-05.mp3
Reference SHA-256: 033c9f13c1d75f255e1aea7094225c72e681e5061d957c99f46088c269c6e470

144 practice clips are generated once before publication and served with this
site. The app makes no runtime Google Translate/TTS request, needs no API key,
and does not send your answers or progress to Google. Fonts remain self-hosted.

Client documentation: https://gtts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/
Client repository: https://github.com/pndurette/gTTS
This is not Google Cloud TTS, an official Google integration or an endorsement.
gTTS is a third-party client of undocumented Translate speech functionality;
future regeneration can be affected by upstream changes. Prepared files continue
to play independently of that service. The client's MIT license does not by
itself grant a license to Google's service or voice output.

Speech is synthetic. The owner approved a voice reference; this does not claim
that a native teacher has individually reviewed all 144 questions. Pinyin shows
dictionary tones; natural tonal sandhi may differ.

The former Icefall AISHELL-3 audio bank is no longer used in this release.
Fonts: DM Sans and Manrope, SIL OFL 1.1; notices included in fonts/.
